model: RGSP-K ERV with optional BACnet field device
applies_to: Tempeff RGSP-K dual-core energy recovery ventilators fitted with the optional BACnet MS/TP field device.
summary: The RGSP-K has no native BACnet; an optional Functional Devices BACnet RIB relay module wired to the unit terminal strip gives a BMS four binary outputs (enable, heat recovery / free cooling, fan speed) and four binary inputs (fan / damper status, furnace interlock, two spare dry contacts) over BACnet MS/TP.
notes: From Figure 22 "BACnet Points List" in the installation manual (page 13). Names are the module's generic object names.
BI 1 is on when the fans run at high speed and flashes 2 s on / 2 s off for a damper alarm.
BI 3 and BI 4 are spare dry-contact inputs, e.g. for damper end switches, current sensors or a CO2 / humidity switch.
The device shows on the network as "Functional Devices BACnet RIB".

integration.summary: Enable the unit with BO 1, choose heat recovery or free cooling with BO 2 and high or low fan speed with BO 3; read BI 1 for high speed / damper alarm and BI 2 for the furnace / AHU interlock.

minimum_points.why: On = heat recovery, off = free cooling
minimum_points.name: BINARY_OUTPUT:2

minimum_points.why: On = high speed, off = low speed
minimum_points.name: BINARY_OUTPUT:3

minimum_points.why: High speed; 2 s flashing = damper alarm
minimum_points.name: BINARY_INPUT:1

setup: BACnet MS/TP only; MS/TP address and baud rate are set with DIP switches on the module.
Default device instance is 277XXX, where XXX is the MS/TP address.
Relay R6 on the unit controller must be rewired to a dry contact (move the black wire to R6 COM, remove the red factory wire) before connecting the module inputs.
gotchas: The module binary inputs must see dry contacts only.
Install the module on the supplied MT4-6 mounting track and power it from 24 V ac/dc.
